title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1983-06-20
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: An epic 1983 show captured in an improved audience recording that delivers a near‑perfect listening experience, especially the unstoppable second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this June 20 1983 performance, calling it “ridiculously good” and highlighting a second‑set that rolls nonstop as a banger. The audio is described as an upgraded audience tape – the best available until a soundboard source surfaces – with enjoyable clarity despite inherent limits.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews praising both the musical performance and the quality of the audience recording; strong show weight with minor recording limitations yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Improved audience tape praised as near‑best possible without an SBD; listeners note some inherent limits but find the sound enjoyable and clear enough for full appreciation.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as a continuous banger from start to finish, indicating strong pacing and momentum throughout.
